description: DESCRIBE VIEW answers a view's COLUMN SHAPE - the same thirteen columns DESCRIBE TABLE answers: canonical types, kind COLUMN, no default/key flags on derived columns, the view's own declared column comments (a base column's never leaks in), materialized views the same; the three relation kinds are interchangeable (DESCRIBE TABLE on a view answers the view, DESCRIBE VIEW on a table answers the table) and the named kind is spoken only in the missing-object refusal. Converted 1:1 from ddl/DescribeViewTest (now retired).
